mechanism: Replace classical CCI mean/MAD with Theil–Sen location (median of all pairwise half-sums) and MAD-of-residuals (median |price−mean|). Output (price−robust_mean)/robust_sd. Compared Classical / Square (RMS) / Modern (robust) on EURUSD H1 2021; robust cut large losses vs classic MAD.
data_needed: Applied-price series (PRICE_TYPICAL default); period≥3 (classic 14); optional level~150 for crossings.
why_new_for_mis: Short-window robust deviation sensor for MIS volatility/stretch without requiring N≥30 classical moments—outlier-resistant CCI variant.
quote: Such situations require robust statistical methods. They make it possible to obtain fairly stable and reliable parameter estimates even in very extreme situations, which are so abundant in the financial markets.

mechanism: tCCI: run robust CCI; after each zero-level crossing, accumulate signed CCI until next zero cross; compare running sum to separate mean uptrend and downtrend sums. Emits trend start/end and relative strength; mean-reversion hint when completed trend exceeds its average.
data_needed: Robust CCI series; zero-cross events; running means of completed up/down accumulated sums.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same EURUSD H1 setup as mCCI; chart illustration of accumulated trend amounts
why_new_for_mis: Turns signed stretch into an episode sensor—duration×intensity of directional regimes for MIS change/regime streams.
quote: With this indicator, we can assess the beginning of a trend, its end and strength.

mechanism: Build close±k·ATR bands; run N MAs (periods ma_faster+i·step). Per bar count_ma starts at N; +1 if MA>upper band, −1 if MA<lower. Color candles by count; auxiliary buffer = N−count (MAs above/below). Graded bullish/bearish consensus vs volatility envelope.
data_needed: iATR(period), N×iMA, close OHLC; atr_band_multiplier; ma_step/method.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: PERIOD_CURRENT chart example; atr_period=10, multiplier=0.8; 10 MAs from period 14 step 2
why_new_for_mis: Multi-MA vs ATR-band vote count is a continuous regime-consensus sensor (how many smoothers sit outside a vol envelope)—usable as graded trend strength for MIS.
quote: we will use a color candle plot to change the coloring of the candles depending on how many MAs are above/below the bands.

mechanism: Normalize FIR weights to sum=1; center=Σ w_i·(i+1). Classify by center vs period: Trend if center<period/3; Smoothing if period/3<center<2·period/3; Countertrend if center>2·period/3. Shiftable cosine/polynomial windows move center to get trending vs countertrend filters from one kernel.
data_needed: Price window; coefficient string or window params (C1..C5 / adaptive polynomial); period and computed center.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 2021.01.01–2021.12.31 EA tests; generic chart indicators
why_new_for_mis: Maps FIR lag/lead geometry into an explicit trend vs countertrend regime label for MIS filter banks—not just SMA/EMA names.
quote: Trend: center < period/3; Smoothing: period/3 < center < 2*period/3; Countertrend: 2*period/3 < center

mechanism: Oscillator = IndA−IndB with Σ weights = 0 (two different windows, same window different lengths, or same window lagged). Sign change of oscillator = MA-cross event. Extra oscillators on each leg’s own Δ filter false crosses when both lines move same way.
data_needed: Two FIR coefficient sequences; optional Δ oscillators on each parent indicator.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 2021; SMA/TMA/MT4/MT5/Crazy pairs in EA Indicator
why_new_for_mis: Canonicalizes cross signals as zero-sum oscillator sign flips plus derivative gates—clean change events for MIS.
quote: all strategies that use the intersection of two indicators as signals can be reduced to one oscillator.

mechanism: Predict next-bar log-price change from many short−long MA spreads on log prices. Coordinate-descent elastic net (α∈(0,1), λ path from GetLambdaThreshold) with soft-thresholding zeros betas; OptimizeLambda k-fold CV picks λ maximizing OOS explained variance. Surviving non-zero betas = active scale sensors.
data_needed: LogPrices indicator; Num_MA_periods×(short−long) EMA/SMA spreads; look-ahead BarsLookAhead; α, n_folds, n_lambda.
why_new_for_mis: Sparse multi-scale MA-spread selection under elastic-net regularization—MIS can treat non-zero betas / active-set size along the λ path as a feature-importance and complexity sensor for forward returns.
quote: Using elastic net regression we can minimize overfitting whilst also being able to separate useless indicators from those that have significant predictive potential.

mechanism: OnTester metrics: avg RR, Sunny Harris CPCIndex (min(PF,RF)×winrate×RR), Van Tharp monthly SQN = (mean/σ)·√min(100,n) averaged over months. Random even/odd entry EA demo only.
why_new_for_mis: No market sensing idea after full read—EA backtest quality scores (SQN/CPC), not market regime sensors.
quote: The second quality factor we'll talk about is called System Quality Index (SQN). It was created by Van Tharp.

mechanism: Particle swarm: v←w·v+c1·rp·(pbest−x)+c2·rg·(gbest−x); PSOm adds parabolic-biased copy of better particles’ coordinates. Benchmarked on Skin/Forest/Megacity—optimization AO module, not a market sensor.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Synthetic Skin/Forest/Megacity fitness; EURUSD M1 only as chart host for test stand
why_new_for_mis: No market sensing idea after full read—population optimizer for EA/NN hyperparameters.
quote: the optimization algorithm is not an independent program, but a separate module or "black box".

mechanism: Modified ACO for continuous spaces: fitness as pheromone at ant sites; move toward other ants by pheromone×inverse-distance scores with PheromoneRadius slip and PathDeviation noise. AO toolkit for NN/EA search.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Skin/Forest/Megacity benchmarks; EURUSD M1 test-stand host
why_new_for_mis: No market sensing idea after full read—continuous ant-colony optimizer, not a price sensor.
quote: we will have to develop a new universal algorithm, so that it can pass our special tests, i.e. it should be a brand new ACO.

mechanism: All (or end) FIR weights updated each bar by least-squares corrections R=price·Error·M that drive prediction error toward 0 while keeping R small; P≥1 slows adaptation. Sum of weights need not stay 1 (potential instability). Adaptive EMA uses independent C1,C2 on price and prior output.
data_needed: Price window of length N; prior coefficients; convergence factor M from Σprice²; P rate parameter.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Generic MT5 charts; Adaptive CCI example; P=1 vs P=1000 comparisons
why_new_for_mis: Online self-tuning linear filter whose coefficients track local market structure—MIS regime sensor that adapts without fixed SMA/EMA periods.
quote: an adaptive indicator is a regular linear indicator with its ratios being able to change over time depending on the current market situation.

mechanism: Moonset: pick a center price in the window; weight each bar by distance in price (not time)—linear, quadratic, or exp decay of |p−p_center|/width. Output Σw·p/Σw. Emphasizes prices near the chosen level (cluster) over temporal lag.
data_needed: Period-length price sample; center index; Smoothing∈{Linear,Quadratic,Exponential}.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart comparison vs SMA; generic symbol/TF
why_new_for_mis: Kernel in price space rather than time—MIS level-proximity / congestion sensor distinct from lag-based MAs.
quote: we will create a window function not in the time domain, but in the price domain.

mechanism: Same LMS adaptation but error = future open − predicted open; emit open[−1] forecast plus running mean forecast error. Probabilistic variant uses Pascal-signed discrete velocity/acceleration terms with constrained adaptive c1,c2.
data_needed: Open prices; adaptive coefficients; optional 1st/2nd divided differences.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Open-based prediction charts; Linear_Prediction / Linear_Probabilistic_Forecast attachments
why_new_for_mis: Online linear predictor of next open with tracked error—sequence sensor for MIS short-horizon expected move.
quote: if we use the difference between the indicator value and the future (in relation to the indicator itself) price as an error, then the adaptive indicator will turn into a predictive one.

mechanism: Artificial bee colony: ranked nectar areas, dance-proportional worker flights, scout flights near areas; ABCm uses fixed-size swarms. Benchmark AO—not market sensing.
why_new_for_mis: No market sensing idea after full read—bee-colony metaheuristic for optimization.
quote: The idea of the algorithm is based on the bee behavior when searching for places where they can get as much nectar as possible.

mechanism: Within period, sort prices ascending (p[]) and descending (P[]); apply same LWMA weights to both. Gap between upper and lower synthetic LWMA = path-extremal trend strength; proximity of live LWMA to a bound = bullish/bearish strength; bound separation ≈ volatility.
data_needed: Price window; LWMA weights for chosen period.
why_new_for_mis: Ordinal-statistics trend-strength sensor: how close price path is to pure mono-trend under fixed weights—regime+vol dual readout for MIS.
quote: the closer the indicator comes to the lower or upper border, the stronger the bullish or bearish trend. In addition, the difference between the upper and lower lines can hint at the market volatility.

mechanism: Pack Open/High/Low of last k bars into (value,index) pairs; ArraySort by price; break ties by index; encode permutation as base-10 (or larger) integer. Accumulate next-bar high−open vs open−low sums per pattern id; on revisit, forecast dominant direction. Along=same on indicator history; Across=order among a bank of MAs.
data_needed: OHLC (or indicator values) for pattern depth; historical pattern→Δ tallies; Least min count; Percent dominance.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Pattern indicator / EA Along Across; 10-point OHLC pack example; 10 MAs periods 2n+1
why_new_for_mis: Permutation hash of local OHLC (or multi-MA order) is a discrete sequence-state sensor—MIS can index microstructures without brittle candlestick name lists.
quote: analyze the index sequence. For the convenience of analysis, convert the indices into a single number… This number will be the final characteristic of the pattern.

mechanism: Grey Wolf Optimizer: α/β/δ leaders; omega toward geometric center with a=√(2(1−epoch/epochs)) shrinking radii. AO for smooth high-D functions / NN training—not a market sensor.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Updated Skin/Forest/Megacity stand; EURUSD M1 host
why_new_for_mis: No market sensing idea after full read—grey-wolf population optimizer.
quote: This is one of the top algorithms for use in training neural networks, smooth functions with many variables.

mechanism: Cuckoo search with Levy flights xi←xi+α⊕levy; nest replacement with pa abandonment; COAm adds per-coordinate change probability for high-D crystallization. Optimization AO leaderboard entry—not market sensing.
why_new_for_mis: No market sensing idea after full read—cuckoo/Levy metaheuristic optimizer.
quote: cuckoo search requires only four understandable parameters, so tuning becomes a no-brainer.
